reviews.name: Abbe
reviews.body: So hydrating and soothing, i leave it on as a face mask before makeup

reviews.name: T.L
reviews.body: I usually use it as a quick 5–10 minute mask before makeup, and it makes my foundation apply so smoothly.

reviews.name: Chloe
reviews.body: I have used these once before an event and although I liked the feel of them I haven’t reached for them again. Personally I prefer a sheet mask and although a little messier/ trickier it is just personal preference for overall hydration.

reviews.name: Flufg
reviews.body: I love these. I slap one on each cheek while I'm brushing my teeth like a mini face mask. They are so cooling.

reviews.name: Anonymous
reviews.body: Very hydrating and good for sensitive skin, highly recommend.
